title: CLI Template Management
summary: This module provides functionalities for managing CLI templates, including copying template files to create new projects and defining example crew structures. It helps users quickly set up new CrewAI projects with predefined configurations.

nodes.label: CLI Commands
nodes.title: CLI Commands Module
nodes.description: The module containing various command-line interface commands, such as 'template add' and 'template list', which interact with template management functionalities.

nodes.label: Copy Template Files
nodes.title: Copy Template Files
nodes.description: Copies predefined template files for a new CrewAI project, including configuration, source code, and tools, to a specified directory. It handles file content replacement based on project name and class name.

nodes.label: Local File System
nodes.title: Local File System
nodes.description: The storage system where new project files and templates are created and managed.

nodes.label: Define Sample Content Crew
nodes.title: Content Crew Definition
nodes.description: Provides a blueprint for a 'Content Crew' with predefined agents (planner, writer, editor) and tasks (planning, writing, editing). It uses YAML configuration files for agent and task settings.

nodes.label: YAML Configuration Files
nodes.title: YAML Configuration Files
nodes.description: External YAML files used to configure agents and tasks within the crew templates, allowing for flexible and declarative crew definitions.

nodes.label: Crew Orchestration
nodes.title: Agent & Crew Orchestration
nodes.description: The core module responsible for managing and executing agents and crews, which would utilize the crew definitions provided by templates.

groups.label: Template Creation
groups.title: Template Creation Logic
groups.description: Handles the programmatic creation and population of new project structures from predefined templates.

groups.label: Template Definitions
groups.title: Example Crew Definitions
groups.description: Contains example structures and configurations for different types of AI crews, serving as templates for new projects.
